DCK Report
T0:00 approx. 25 mg DCK nasally
T0:30 I start to feel warmth in my nasal cavity and a calmness
T0:35 I feel heavy, clumsy surprisingly tired
T0:40 the lyrics of the songs I've been listening to during the day but not at the moment are playing in my head
T0:55 the colours are more beautiful, I know I'm lying in my bed in my room but when I don't move my body just my eyes it feels like something is off with my room (I know it is not) like they put me in a box and now I'm a miniature
T1:00 fatigue leaves me I'm starting to be rather stimulated, I haven't been nauseous yet I'm not experiencing any negative effects, I needed to go to the toilet walking around gave me a weird feeling, I saw myself in the mirror no change, the light bulb in the bathroom is incredibly loud.
T1:05 after coming from the toilet the bed is like cotton completely soft
T1:30 Euphoria while listening to music
T1:50 tears appeared probably from me being happy, slight dissociation
T2:00 fatigue comes back, I'm slowed down, mind relatively clear, peak probably behind me
T2:15 motor skills impaired still, don't know if it was my imagination or if I had a visual of a flashing light in the dark ?
T2:25 I smoked a bong from HHC pen 96% 5 puffs on red as a reward for a good night
T4:00 finishend
